summary.headline: Happiest Minds to merge into ITC Infotech; promoter Soota sells 22.1% for ~INR 1,330 crore cash, ITC to hold ~73.4% of combined entity.
summary.overview: This special call covered the proposed combination of Happiest Minds with ITC Infotech, not a quarterly results update. Promoter Ashok Soota will divest 22.1% of his 44.2% stake in two cash tranches (about INR 1,330 crore total) to ITC Infotech. Happiest Minds will be amalgamated into ITC Infotech, with its shareholders receiving 25 ITC Infotech shares for every 81 Happiest Minds shares. Management targets USD 1 billion revenue by FY28 (earlier FY31) and a combined operating margin of about 18.1-18.3%. Management declined to give detail on integration, leadership, client overlap and AI revenue, citing the pending CCI approval.

financial_highlights.metric: ITC Infotech revenue FY20 to FY26

segments.name: Happiest Minds (standalone)
segments.commentary: FY26 EBITDA margin 17.3%; valued at 15.1x FY26 EBITDA; brings AI, digital, product engineering, cloud, data and cybersecurity capabilities. Management said it sustained similar growth to ITC Infotech over the last one to two years.

segments.name: ITC Infotech
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue about INR 4,718 crore, roughly 2.17x Happiest Minds; EBITDA margin 18.3%; valued at 13.6x FY26 EBITDA. Strengths in SAP, PLM, Industry 4.0, enterprise applications and transformation. ITC Limited wholly owns it and it is unlisted.

guidance_outlook: Targets USD 1 billion revenue by FY28 (earlier target FY31); management said the 14-15% growth required is in INR terms, converted at about INR 95-96 per USD, and FX moves would need adjustment.

Combined operating margin expected at about 18.3% plus, with a stated 100 bps margin expansion post-merger from scale, SG&A absorption, office consolidation and bench/utilisation efficiencies; no timeline given.
Tranche 1 of the Soota sale follows CCI approval, expected Q3 FY27; Tranche 2 follows merger shareholder approval, expected Q1 FY28.
Listing of merged entity expected Q2/Q3 FY28; overall completion expected over about 15 months.
Management said more detail on integration, incentives, structure and cross-sell would come after CCI approval, possibly at a January investor call.
Synergies around 10% were referenced by an analyst; management did not quantify synergies in the call.
capex_capacity: No capex, capacity or utilisation figures were discussed.
Combined workforce of more than 19,000 professionals; more than 9,000 AI-trained professionals across the combined entity.
Both entities continue operating separately until all regulatory approvals are received.
demand_pricing: Combined client base of more than 800 customers across more than 30 countries; ITC Infotech has 50+ Fortune Global 500 and 16+ FTSE 100 clients (per ITC PR, cited by CFO).
Combined geography: approximately 38% Americas, 31% Europe, 31% rest of world.
Combined vertical mix: CPG and retail 28% (largest, ITC Infotech strength), BFSI 20%, manufacturing and industrial 17%, travel and hospitality 12%, healthcare and ed-tech roughly 6-7% each.
Management said no overlap among top/large customers; overlap likely limited to smaller tail accounts; the 800-customer review not yet done.
Cross-sell opportunities cited: AI, data, cybersecurity into ITC Infotech accounts; SAP, PLM, Oracle, infrastructure into Happiest Minds accounts (CPG, retail, manufacturing, healthcare).
Partner ecosystem includes Microsoft, SAP, ServiceNow, PTC, Google, Amazon and cybersecurity vendors.

qa_highlights.question: Who will lead the combined entity and what are incentive and continuity plans?
qa_highlights.answer: Leadership, roles and incentives will be discussed only after CCI approval; both sides committed to retaining all people. No contracts exist for top management beyond meeting of minds.

qa_highlights.question: Client overlap between the two entities?
qa_highlights.answer: Management sees no overlap among large customers and very limited overlap in tail accounts; full 800-customer analysis to follow in a couple of months.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 14% ITC Infotech CAGR organic or inorganic, and what are the near-term targets?
qa_highlights.answer: Largely organic per financial due diligence; only Blazeclan (cloud) and an earlier PTC acquisition. Near-term focus is cross-selling and turnkey large deals after CCI approval; no quantified synergy targets given.

qa_highlights.question: Why was the open offer not triggered?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the trigger is above 24% stake; the sale happens in two 11% tranches (about 22% total), so no open offer.

qa_highlights.question: Why does the promoter retain about 7.5% post-merger and why was merger structured this way?
qa_highlights.answer: Partial liquidity was the aim; the remainder shares in future growth. Minimum public shareholding (25%) rules meant ITC cannot take 100%, so Happiest Minds merges into ITC Infotech rather than the reverse.

qa_highlights.question: Why does Happiest Minds carry a higher valuation multiple (15.1x vs 13.6x)?
qa_highlights.answer: Independent valuers cited the AI-led positioning, recency of business mix, growth record over five years and listed status, versus ITC Infotech's customer list.

qa_highlights.question: How is the INR 395 transaction price different from INR 405 implied value?
qa_highlights.answer: Tranche 1 at INR 390 and Tranche 2 at INR 400 average to INR 395; INR 405 is the valuation-exercise value used for the swap ratio, about INR 10 higher.

qa_highlights.question: How will margin expansion of 100 bps occur and when?
qa_highlights.answer: Via scale (SG&A absorption over a base about 2.17x larger), office consolidation, and better bench utilisation and deployment; no timeline provided.

qa_highlights.question: What is the impact of the ITC rights issue into ITC Infotech?
qa_highlights.answer: ITC, as sole owner of ITC Infotech, will fund the share purchase through a rights issue; management said this was factored into the swap ratio with no valuation impact.

qa_highlights.question: Quantify AI revenue contribution and visibility beyond USD 1 billion.
qa_highlights.answer: No AI revenue figure given; management will track cross-sell index, large-deal proposals and conversion, TCV and order book, with details expected in a few months.

risks_watch: CCI approval (expected Q3 FY27) gates Tranche 1 of the Soota sale; Tranche 2 depends on merger shareholder approval (expected Q1 FY28) and NCLT sanction, with overall completion over about 15 months.
USD 1 billion FY28 target needs 14-15% INR-terms growth; FX at about INR 95-96 per USD (management said adjustment needed if the dollar moves toward INR 100).

Margin path: 18.1% pro-forma FY26 combined EBITDA margin with a stated 100 bps expansion from scale, SG&A absorption, office consolidation and bench utilisation; no timeline or quantified synergies given.
Retention risk in sales teams and delivery staff during the long integration window; no contractual retention for top management, and leadership and incentive plans deferred until after CCI approval.

Client overlap review across the 800-plus customer base is pending (expected in a couple of months); cross-sell index, large-deal conversion, TCV and order book flagged as future KPIs, with AI revenue contribution not quantified.
ITC Infotech financials are unlisted and pro-forma; time-and-material mix and detailed segment numbers not yet disclosed.
key_quotes: Yesterday, we announced the proposed combination of Happiest Minds and ITC Infotech.
I should be honest that our goal of our possibility of reaching that goal looked difficult earlier, now but it is very well within sight.
In terms of client overlap, again, we've looked at the large customers and we've not seen any overlap so far.
Whereas INR405 is the implied valuation or whatever the outcome of a valuation exercise conducted by PwC and Grant Thornton and opined on by ICICI Securities.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident on the strategic rationale and transaction structure, but guarded on operational detail. It repeatedly deferred questions on leadership, incentives, client-level overlap, AI revenue contribution, synergy quantification and T&M mix to after CCI approval or to a January investor call, citing the pending regulatory process.

growth.why: No capacity, capex or utilisation was discussed; the only growth figure is the USD 1 billion by FY28 target, which implies about 14-15% INR growth a year (management's own framing), backed by a raised target but no orders or capacity.
